content.text:
Final submission recorded; no further tool calls.

- **Status:** deviation on § 12.4 (p0045), with § 12.3 (p0044) cited as the conflicting favourable text.
- **Validated redline:** one replace — "Customer **may** solicit, hire, or employ Vendor employees **without restriction**." (propose_redline ok:true, minimality ok).
- **Element coverage (preferred):** the sole element, "Customer has no non-solicitation restriction.", is addressed_by_operation 1 in operative language.
- **Deterministic flags:** the 12-month duration and general-solicitation carve-out checks are inapplicable on the preferred path — no covenant remains to date-limit or carve out from — and the mutual, 12-month, involvement-limited version with both carve-outs and no no-hire is preserved in the comment as our fallback offer.
